entries.original_title: New repository deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
entries.subtitle: The repository presents a research prototype coding agent for one GitHub repository that handles work requests and shows tasks needing human attention.
entries.reject_reason: DeepSeek uploaded a research-prototype code repository, not a new named model or an announced product launch.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
entries.subtitle: WISD trains reasoning models against weaker quantized or pruned versions, improving average accuracy by 4.0 and 5.5 percentage points without privileged information.
entries.reject_reason: The independent self-distillation paper uses Qwen models as test subjects but is not research from Qwen.

entries.subtitle: AMD uploaded amd/Qwen3-0.6B_rai_1.9.0_m_1.0.1_npu, an ONNX conversational text-generation model tagged for Ryzen AI and Apache-2.0.
entries.reject_reason: AMD uploaded NPU-compatible conversions of existing Qwen models, not a new named model or version.

entries.original_title: Paper page - ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics
entries.subtitle: ABF-Bench tests blockchain tracing agents with evidence-backed tasks, requiring ledger citations and exposing gaps in recall and agent overconfidence.
entries.reject_reason: The Imperial College benchmark merely evaluates tools associated with tracked entities; its research is not from one.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Broken on Arrival: Non-Functional Quantized LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them
entries.subtitle: Tests found seven official tags (2.3%) solved at most six tasks, while an importance matrix raised three builds from zero to 76-113 solved tasks.
entries.reject_reason: The independent study tests public quantized models but is not research from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
entries.subtitle: The paper proposes one likelihood-based method to combine static data and reinforcement learning during foundation-model training, aiming to improve efficiency and retain capabilities.
entries.reject_reason: This is a Carnegie Mellon research paper; the tracked model named in the page only generated its summary.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Matched Capabilities, Different Behaviors: A Controlled Study of MCP and CLI Interfaces for Language Agents
entries.subtitle: Across six models and three interactive environments, the study found that MCP and CLI interfaces changed agent task performance and interaction cost despite matched capabilities.
entries.reject_reason: The MCP-versus-CLI agent study is from an untracked research group, not a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
entries.subtitle: EPSBench evaluates forecasting agents across 149 firm-quarters from 86 US companies, comparing earnings predictions with analyst consensus and testing interval coverage.
entries.reject_reason: The earnings-forecasting benchmark is from Georgia Tech, not a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
entries.subtitle: The paper adapts pretrained raster-scan image models for any-order generation, enabling inpainting and outpainting with minimal extra compute.
entries.reject_reason: This image-generation research is not attributed to a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
entries.subtitle: Holo4D uses reconstructed 3D scene trajectories to guide video diffusion, helping generate new camera views while preserving observed geometry and motion.
entries.reject_reason: Holo4D is university research rather than a development from a tracked entity.

entries.original_title: Paper page - FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
entries.subtitle: FDSML uses image-generation parameters to train embeddings, improving transfer to image retrieval and robustness while remaining competitive on downstream classification.
entries.reject_reason: The metric-learning paper is not research from a tracked entity.
